method: No evaluator or structural_statics function imported. Raw native contacts and reported transforms/mass rows reconstruct vector cross-product forces/moments. Free extremes independently enumerate 3-contact equilibrium vertices. Independent minimax LP uses raw Nm coefficients and capacity*t inequalities.
scope: Algebraic normal-only quasistatic model validated; no actual robot qualification, dynamics/friction/connectivity/thermal/bus validation.

dual_certificate_summary.scope: Numeric lower bound certifies exclusion only inside stated finite normal/contact/mapped-capacity algebraic model.

interpretation_findings: Worst unconstrained contact allocation exceeding capacity does not prove nonexistence of one common actuator-constrained allocation.
All 18 speed/eta/motor-factor scenarios per load case are gear-T0-capped and have the same LP capacities; they are not 18 independently validated actual operating capabilities.
Recorded primal with t<=1 certifies existence in hypotheses; primal t>1 alone does not certify absence. Independent dual lower bounds were added here.
A failed solver would need UNKNOWN interpretation rather than proof of infeasibility; all this batch succeeded.
